# Sarkar — full brand summary

## About
Sarkar is a premium unisex fragrance house from India, co-founded by Bhuvan Bam (actor, content creator, co-founder of BBKV Productions), Neel Gogia (co-founder of IPLIX Media and Layers), Rohit Raj (manager of Bhuvan Bam, co-founder of BBKV Productions) and Jag Chima (co-founder of IPLIX Media). It launched in August 2026 after nearly three years of development, aiming to bridge the gap between mass-market body sprays and luxury niche perfumes. Fragrances: Throne, Regal, Noble, Orion, Vantage.

## Product: Vantage (100ml)
- Type: unisex spiced woody parfum, 25% oil concentration
- Longevity: up to 8 hours on most skin
- Top: grapefruit, ginger. Heart: cardamom, violet leaf. Base: cedarwood, vetiver, ambergris
- Wear: daily or for decisive moments (negotiations, interviews, match point); summer and winter
- Price: ₹1,499 incl. of all taxes

## Shipping & returns
- Free shipping across India; ships in 24–36 hours
- Launch offer: 2 complimentary 7ml samples with every order
- Returns: policy to be published
